name: Cohort 01
heroStatement: We don't just build engineers. We build founders.
tagline: A Hacker House / Venture Lab for IIT Delhi's most ambitious builders. 3 months. Real problems. No equity taken by SInC.

objectives.title: Real learning by doing
objectives.description: Pick a real problem and work on it for three months — not a thesis-for-the-sake-of-thesis project.

objectives.title: Ventures that get created
objectives.description: The explicit goal is great ventures out of IIT Delhi in the next two to three years. Every structural choice compounds toward this.

objectives.title: Cross-border talent pollination
objectives.description: Not everyone becomes a founder. Some join European or US startups, or work on licensed IP. The cohort opens founder and operator doors.

tracks.title: Open track
tracks.description: Bring your own hypothesis. Same bar — strong builder, sharp idea, early proof of concept.

selection.title: Education & applications
selection.description: Tracks published in a documented report. Five on-campus talks — one per track. Applications open alongside.

selection.title: Hackathon sprint
selection.description: One-week sprint. Teams ship a hypothesis with literature/validation and an early POC. Evaluated on builder strength and hypothesis strength.

selection.title: Final selection
selection.description: 5–10 ventures selected. Strong builder + strong hypothesis go through directly. Others may get a short retry window. Non-selected applicants feed builder and hypothesis reserves.

plan.title: Selection sprint
plan.description: One-week hackathon. Build a hypothesis, ship an early POC. We're looking for strong builders and sharp hypotheses.

plan.title: Build & validate
plan.description: 3 months of execution (20 Sep – 20 Dec). Weekly SInC check-ins, biweekly mentor reviews, monthly progress gates.

plan.title: Funding & growth
plan.description: Propose what you need at monthly gates. Capital via SAFEs or milestone tranches based on traction shown.

plan.title: Demo Day
plan.description: Present to seed investors, alumni, and partners. Don't raise? You retain full rights to your IP and entity.

benefits.title: Build budget & cloud
benefits.description: Up to ₹43,000/month per venture for APIs, AWS/GCP, AI tooling, and incorporation — reimbursed against actual bills.

benefits.title: Founder fellowship
benefits.description: ₹20,000/month stipend for every selected student, equity-free, separate from any venture investment.

benefits.title: Investor intros
benefits.description: Investor Connect sessions, Demo Day exposure, and pre-seed conversations for the strongest ventures.

benefits.title: Legal & workspace
benefits.description: IP assignment to your venture (not SInC), co-founder agreements, and optional FITT R&I Park workspace.

rules: You own your IP. Every student signs an IP assignment to their own venture, not SInC.
Real learning by doing — you must ship, not just pitch.
Weekly check-ins are the floor. Disengagement without communication leads to removal.
Funding is proposal-based, primarily via SAFEs, at investor discretion.
5–10 ventures selected across 5 pre-decided tracks + 1 open track.
